intent: Root-provided biometric telemetry service using HttpClient. Public API: TelemetryService.getSnapshot(): Observable<BiometricMetric> (GET /api/telemetry/snapshot); TelemetryService.streamLive(intervalMs: number): Observable<BiometricMetric> (polls GET /api/telemetry/stream every intervalMs with timer+switchMap; for each metric exceeding DEFAULT_TELEMETRY_THRESHOLDS calls ToastStore.show(message: string, severity: ToastSeverity): string with severity 'warning', throttled per metric kind). Consumes ToastStore.show(message: string, severity: ToastSeverity): string.
